title: No writings in the Great Pyramid
summary: Matt tells of No writings in the Great Pyramid, about ancient Egypt at Egypt (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: for instance in the Great Pyramid of Giza there are no writings anywhere

plain: A researcher named Matt, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, says that inside the Great Pyramid of Giza in Egypt there are no writings anywhere. He raises it as a puzzle, since it would leave open who built the pyramid and why.
